--- Page 5 --- AGANCHENGANI "Ku-sikni Bidingo Seanirang"- ko anga essayni bimango sea.
Ia tom.chimonggipao seanirang mingchikking donga.
Seani- rangoni mitamrangde baditaba bilsirangni gisepo ong-atgipa semanchagiparang.
Ia seanirang Ku-sikni (Language) bidingo ong-a, sea-jotani (Literature) bidingkode man-chapatja.

la seanirangko dakmitingo anga David Abercrombieni ki-tap "Problems and Principles in Language Study", Garo Grammar Ki-taprang aro Robins Burlingni A-chikku Grammarni bidingo segipa ki-taprangko niaha aro jakkalaha.
(i) "Ku-sikko Jakkalani" essayo, Ku-sikara maia aro songsarni gita manderangni janggi tanganio uni kamara maia uko nia.
(ii) "Phonetics"- ni gimin seanio, A-chikkuni sound unitrangni ba gam-ani tokrangni gimin nia, indiba ian kosakgilgil nianisan ong-aia; sandirikkite seanio gitade ningtuani dongja.
(ii) "A.
- chikkuo Katta Rikani aro Bariani" essayo, A-chikkuo kattana kangalgijanioni a-bachenge, A-chikku kattarangko tom.
- chimongna a-bachenganiko janapjole, Achikkuo katta rikna mai chol-bewalrangko jakkala aro mai cholrangchi A-chikku kattarang baridapa, uko nia.
(iv)“A-chikkuo ‘Raka' () Jakkalani" ingipa seanio, ‘Raka'- ni mongsongani aro A.chikkuo seanio gelna man'gijagipa bak ong-aniko nia.
Chasong gitalni bi-sarangoni bang-aan badia kattao aro kattani badia bako 'Raka' totna nanga talja.
A-chik bi.sarangko iako ma'sie ra-atania ku-tangko jakkalanio namdapatani ong-a.
(v) "A-chikku Grammar Ki-taprang" segimin ki-taprangko nipile, uarangni mongsonggipa niksenggipa bakrangko niani ong-a.

(vi) “Garo Grammarni Bimango Gipin Grammarni Bilmanani" essayo, Garo Grammarko segiparang English Grammarko name poraigiparang ong-ani  gimin aro a-sel, Garo Grammarko seania English Grammarni niamrangehi aditan japindapaniko man-a ine mesokna jotton ka'a.
(vii) "A-chikkuo Verb Jakkalani Adita Niamrang" essayo, sentenceo Verbni biap, sentenceo Verb jakkalani aro jakkalgijani aro uarang gitako nia.
(viii) "A-chikkuo Verbrangni Tense aro Aspect" ingipa seanio, Tenseo daka-ka-ani Verbnibimang aro (i) --- Page 6 --- mesokmanchaenggipa somoe dingtanggrikna man-aia ine mesoka.
(ix) “English aro A-chikku Tense Systemko Tosusaani" ingipa seanio, Englisho jakkalgipa badia Tenserangko A-chikkuoba jakkala aro badiarangko jakkalna ke-ja uarangko tosusae nia.

(x) "Ku-amani Bilmananichi Ku-gipinko Skie Ra-anio Gualanirang" essayo, Englishko skie ra-gipa A.chik bi-sarang maikai A-chikku Grammarni niamrangni bilmananichi Englisho seanio badiaba gualanirangko daka aro indonga gualanirangko uisamsoe ra-aniara mai namgniko on-a, uarangko nia.
A-chikkuoVerb Jakkalani Niamrang, A-chikkuo Verbrangni Tense aro Aspect aro English aro A-chikku Tense Systemko Tosusaani-ia minggittam seanirango nangrimgrikani baksana apsanangani bang-a.
Verbantinin Tense donga aro Tenseko talatnade Verb gri cholija; ia minggni ma-kaen nangrimgrika.
English Grammarni Tense Systemko ja-rike seaniko Garo Grammar Ki-taprango nika.
Ia ku-sik minggnini Grammarni niamrangko ma-ekatgija aro ma-ekateba skie ra-anichi, uarangko nambate masina man-a.
Indake ia katta bichong minggittam stitgrikani gimin, mitam paragraphrang, sentencerang aro mesokanirangko ra'grikpilaia.
Katta bichong ge-sao segiminko ma-siode, gipinrangko ma-sianio nengrabata.
Name niode, badia katta bichong Grammarni badia bakna mikpakma nia uina man-a.
Ku-sikni Niamrang ba Grammarkode “gisik nangatani grigipa, ran-krekgipa katta bichong" ine mitamrang agana.

Indiba Ku-tangko uiani aro uni Grammarni niamrangko name tale Grammarni niamrangko ja-rikgija seode, golpo, rochona, songsarni golpo, je seaniko seoba, uarangni me-suaniko gimaatgen, maina ma-siani dongjaode, poraie gisik an-sengani dongja.
Poedo seaniosa poedo segiparangna jakgitelaniko ongipa 'poetic licence' donga, jeko jakkalen, poedo segiparang grammarni niamrangko gelna choljoka.
Poedorang aro indaka seanirangko bregiparang aro poraigiparang komibea, indiba indakgipa seanirang dongna nangchongmota ine angko didigiparangko anga gisik ra-a aro uamangna iano mittelaniko ona.

Iano seanirang rama o-rokanisan ong-bataia, indiba iarang sanaba uidapaniko, Achikkuni gimin (1i) --- Page 7 --- ma'sidapaniko aro ia seanirangna ning'tubate aro talbate seanirangko dakna an'saoataniko on'ode, seanirang ong'gramaijawa.
Angni ia seanirangna anga Burlingni ki'taprangko, R.G.
Mominni ki'tapko, Clearson Sangmani Achik Grammar Ki·tapko aro Rev.
Remani Mandi Grammar ki·tapko Dr.
Milton S.
Sangmaoniko man'aha.
Anga bi.jaoba,ua angna ia ki'taprang uo donga ine agane angna uarangko ra'srona on'aha.
Ia Ki'tapna Agandapaniko senaba Dr.
Sangma jechakjaha.
Iarangna anga angni mittelpilaniko Dr.
Sangmana paraka.
Indiba angni mittelpilna nangbatgipara Dr.
Sangmani angko kitap sena didiatani aro an'saoatanian.
Mittelbea, Dr.
Sangma.
Dated Tura, Brucellish K.
Sangma The 1st October, 2005.
(Renangma) (ii) --- Page 8 --- AGANDAPANI Sea-jotaniko dakani neng begipa kam ong'a.
Jeni gimin sena am'oba altua katta ong'ja.
Mikkang ki'sang chanchichengesa sena nanga.
Segimin kattani gimin seode, uko dingtangskae sena ga'aka.
Sechenggipa katta ong'ode, rama o'roke on'chenggipa gita ong'na nanga.
Iarangna agreba, A chikkuchi sea katta ramram ongja.
Mongsongbate rakbegipa aro ning'tubegipa orto gnanggipa kattarangko aro chanchianirangko parakna A-chikkuchi nenga aro chu'onga kattarangko manjanio sena neng'bea.
Indiba A:chikrangni skia-poraiani gadangrang tang'dororobaengahani gimin indakgipa gadangrango poraigiparangna rokom rokom seanirangko da'o nangbeengaha.
Ia “Ku'sikni Bidingo Seanirang"-ko poraie anga kusi ong'a, maina ian A-chikkuni bidingo chugipa gadangrango poraigiparangna dakchakbeani ong'gen.
Iako poraie anga indakeba agandapna ska aro namnika.
Skanggipa, ia Ki-tapko segipani janapani gita, iani bidingo seanirang bilongen komikuenga.
Ku'sikni bidingo rokom rokomrangko uina nangchqngmota,indiba ia uina nangchongmotgipaon an'ching ja'manchakkuenga.
Gnigipa, a'song gipinni aro a'songtangni manderang beben iani bidingo adita see donangaha, indiba uamang English Grammar aro English Ku'sikko niatesa A'chik Grammarrangko seaha.
Gittamgipa, A'chik Grammarko seon, A chikkuni gam'a aro aganani bewalrang aro Achikkuoniko examplerangko on'e seosa chong'motgipa A-chik Grammar ong'gen.
Uarang da'alona kingking komikuenga.
Brigipa, 'Raka' totani A-chikkuni mingsa dingtangbegipa Ku'sikni bewalko mesoka.
la Ki'tapo iako maina jakkalna nangchongmota uko talate on'a.
Je jerangko A'chikkuchi seanirango komikuenga ine janapahachim, uarangoni mitamko ia Ki'tapo kolgapataha ine nikna man'gen.
Anga Mrs.
Sangma (Renangma) ko mittelna ska, maina ua ia rakbegipa subjectko altuae ma'sina man'na gita man'adipet (iv) --- Page 9 --- seaha.
Batanggimin somoerango seanggimin Grammar Ki'taprangkoba nigopate seaniko dakaha.
Uandake ia Kitapko poraion iani bidingo badita nambatrorobaaha uko ma'sina man'a.
Ia Ki:tap College aro Universityo poraigiparangna Ku'sikni bewal aro Grammarni bidingo uina dakchakbeani ong'gen ine nikna man'a.
Iamangna agreba, gipin A'chik Ku'sikni aro Grammarni bidingo uina sikgiparangnaba dakchakbeani ong'gen ineba nikatna man'a.
Uandaken ia Ki-tapko poraie bang'a segipa an'tangan Literatureni mande ong'e, uko skie aro adita ki'tap aro articlerangko see, name ma-siesa iako seaha.
Ian uni jatna gimagijagipa donanggimin gam ong'a.
Dated Tura, Prof.
Milton S.
Sangma The 16th.
February, 2005.
Former Pro-Vice Chancellor NEHU, Tura.
